The math behind your recommended daily goal

Under 18: a fixed 1,500 ml/day — the app's standard recommended minimum. Growing bodies have their own age/sex-based targets that don't scale with weight the way adult estimates do, so we don't try to approximate that with a formula.

18 and older: weight (kg) × 35 ml, then 80% of that total — about 28 ml per kilogram. The 35 ml/kg baseline and the 80/20 drinks-to-food split are both commonly attributed to the European Food Safety Authority's (EFSA) 2010 water guidelines.

This is a general estimate, not medical advice. You can always set your own goal manually in Settings → Personal goal.

1. Overview

 FillMeUp! is a free, offline hydration-tracking application for Android. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it is used, and your rights as a user.

 The App has no servers, no accounts and no analytics. Everything you enter stays in the App's private storage on this device. The only way any of it leaves the device is if you export a backup file yourself (section 6), or if you have Android's own system backup switched on (section 7) — both are under your control.

 ──────────────────────────────

 2. Information We Collect

 2.1 Data stored locally on your device

 The App stores the following information in your device's private app storage:

 • Daily water intake — track progress toward the daily goal
 • Historical daily intake — display the analytics chart and full history
 • Daily goal, personal goal and unit preference — personalise the experience
 • Age and body weight (optional) — calculate your recommended daily goal; the App works without them
 • Reminder schedule configuration — trigger notifications at chosen times
 • Reminder time window — keep repeating reminders inside your waking hours
 • Quick add and remove amounts — remember the buttons you configured
 • Notification quick-log amounts — remember the buttons shown on a reminder and on the home-screen widget
 • Reminder sound choice — play the tone you picked when a reminder arrives
 • Notification preferences — on/off, and whether to pause reminders upon reaching the goal
 • Inactivity reminder — the gap you chose, and when you last logged a drink so that gap can be measured (that timestamp is kept apart from the rest — see 6 and 7)
 • Celebration animations preference — respect your choice for goal celebrations
 • Theme preference — remember your light / dark / colour choice
 • Streak counter — show consecutive days the goal was met
 • Setup, tutorial and release-notes flags — avoid repeating the intro, the profile setup and a version's what's-new notes

 2.2 Data we do NOT collect

 • No name, email address, account or contact details
 • No location data
 • No device identifiers
 • No usage analytics or event telemetry
 • No crash or error reports
 • No camera, microphone, or contacts access
 • No data sent to us or to any third party

 About age and weight: these are the only body-related values the App stores, they are optional, and they exist solely to compute a recommended daily goal on this device. They are never transmitted anywhere and are not linked to any identity, because the App has no notion of who you are. You can change or erase them at any time in Settings → Profile.

 ──────────────────────────────

 3. Internet and Network Access

 The App does not request the INTERNET permission. It cannot open a network connection, and it has no server, cloud service or third-party endpoint to talk to. It is entirely offline by design.

 ──────────────────────────────

 4. Third-Party Libraries

 The App uses open-source libraries that operate strictly on-device:

 • MPAndroidChart — renders the intake bar chart
 • TapTargetView — displays the interactive first-launch tutorial
 • AndroidX / Material Components — standard UI components

 None of these libraries collect, transmit or process personal data. The App ships no advertising, attribution or analytics SDK of any kind.

 ──────────────────────────────

 5. Notifications and the Home-Screen Widget

 Reminders are delivered as local notifications generated entirely on your device using Android's AlarmManager. A reminder may include quick-log buttons that record an amount straight from the notification shade without opening the App; this is handled entirely on-device. No notification content or delivery data is sent to any external service. You can disable notifications at any time from the Reminders screen or your device notification settings.

 If you enable the inactivity reminder, the App records the time of your most recent logged drink so it can measure the gap. That timestamp is the only thing kept for this, and it is overwritten every time you log a drink.

 A reminder can play a sound: your device's own default tone, or one of two short water sounds bundled inside the App. Nothing is streamed or downloaded to play them.

 The home-screen widget

 The optional widget shows today's intake, your goal and how far through it you are, plus the same quick-log buttons. Two things follow from that:

 • Because the widget sits on your home screen, those numbers are visible to anyone who can see your screen, without unlocking the App. If you would rather they were not, simply do not add the widget, or remove it by long-pressing it.
 • The widget reads the App's own local storage directly and is drawn by Android on your device. It needs no additional permission, adds no network access and sends nothing anywhere.

 ──────────────────────────────

 6. Data Export and Import

 The App allows you to export what it has stored to a backup file at a location you choose on your device, and to restore it later by importing that file. The file is plain-text JSON and contains the values listed in 2.1, including your age and weight if you entered them. The App never uploads or transmits it — where the file goes afterwards is up to you, so treat it like any other personal document if you copy it off the device or into cloud storage.

 The time of your last logged drink is held separately from the App's other settings and is deliberately not written to the export file, so a backup you share or archive never reveals when you last drank.

 Importing a backup replaces the App's current data with the contents of the file.

 ──────────────────────────────

 7. Android System Backup

 The App participates in Android's built-in backup mechanism. If system backup is enabled on the device (for example Backup by Google One, or another transport your device provides), Android copies the App's saved preferences — the data in 2.1, including age and weight if entered — into that backup and restores them when the App is reinstalled or the device is migrated.

 • This is performed by the Android operating system, not by the App. The App has no access to the backup and no server of its own.
 • The backup is stored under your own account with your backup provider and is governed by that provider's privacy policy. On current Android versions it is encrypted with your device credentials before leaving the device.
 • Devices without a backup transport never produce such a backup.
 • The first-launch tour flag is deliberately excluded, so the guide replays after a reinstall.
 • The time of your last logged drink is also excluded; it is kept apart from the backed-up settings and never leaves the device.
 • To opt out: turn off backup for the App in Device Settings → Google → Backup (or Settings → System → Backup). Existing backups can be deleted from the same screen.

 ──────────────────────────────

 8. Permissions

 • Display hydration reminder notifications (Android 13+)
 • Reschedule reminders after a device reboot
 • Deliver reminders at the exact times you configured (Android 12+)

 The App also reschedules reminders when the device leaves airplane mode or after an app update; neither requires an additional permission. No other permissions are requested or used.

 ──────────────────────────────

 9. Data Retention and Deletion

 All data is stored locally in your device's private storage and accessible only to the App. To delete it:

 • Clear your age and weight only: Settings → Profile inside the App
 • Clear everything: Device Settings → Apps → FillMeUp! → Storage → Clear Data
 • Or simply uninstall the App.

 These actions do not touch copies outside the App's own storage: any backup file you exported yourself, and any Android system backup, must be deleted separately (sections 6 and 7).

 ──────────────────────────────

 10. Children's Privacy

 The App is not directed at children and collects no personally identifiable information from anyone. If an age under 18 is entered, it is used only to select a fixed recommended minimum instead of the adult weight-based estimate, and it is stored locally exactly like every other setting.

 ──────────────────────────────

 11. Changes to This Policy

 If a future version of the App introduces features that change these data practices, this policy will be updated and the user will be notified.

 ──────────────────────────────
